No diagnoses, country attribution, process names, raw payload claims, or firewall changes. Output at most 3 observations, 3 inferences and 3 next steps. Prioritize a reported block and any specific supplied rule context (STUN, UID fixture, Tailscale) before general novelty commentary. Do not repeat an inference or citation. Use interpretation_catalog meanings; they are possibilities, never proof of an application. The unknown array must start with {"type":"unknown","topic":"intent"} and {"type":"unknown","topic":"complete_visibility"}, in that order. Optionally append process_identity and/or payload. Keep the report concise.
